title: FUTON: Fourier Tensor Networks for Implicit Neural Representations
abstract: arXiv:2602.13414v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Implicit neural representations (INRs) have emerged as powerful tools for encoding signals, yet dominant MLP-based designs often suffer from slow convergence, and how their accuracy depends on their size is known only empirically. We introduce FUTON (Fourier Tensor Network), which models signals as generalized Fourier series whose coefficients are parameterized by a low-rank tensor decomposition, read out by a linear or MLP head. FUTON combines complementary inductive biases: Fourier bases capture smoothness and periodicity, while the low-rank parameterization enforces low-dimensional spectral structure. Beyond universal approximation, we show that with a linear head, the best FUTON's error splits exactly into the truncation of the signal's series and the best low-rank error of its coefficients, which we bracket from the samples before training, with a FUTON that attains the upper bound. translated_title: FUTON：用于隐式神经表示的傅里叶张量网络
translated_abstract: 隐式神经表示（INR）已成为编码信号的强大工具，然而主流的基于MLP的设计往往收敛缓慢，且其精度如何随规模变化仅停留在经验认识层面。我们提出了FUTON（傅里叶张量网络），它将信号建模为广义傅里叶级数，其系数由低秩张量分解进行参数化，并通过线性层或MLP头读出。FUTON结合了互补的归纳偏置：傅里叶基捕捉平滑性与周期性，而低秩参数化则强制实现低维谱结构。在万能逼近之外，我们证明当使用线性头时，最优FUTON的误差可精确分解为信号级数的截断误差与其系数的最优低秩误差之和，后者可在训练前由样本进行界定，并存在一个能达到该上界的FUTON。在图像拟合、占据体积等任务上，FUTON展现出了优越的性能。
tldr: 提出FUTON，一种将信号建模为广义傅里叶级数、并用低秩张量分解参数化傅里叶系数的隐式神经表示方法，它结合傅里叶与低秩两种归纳偏置，实现了精确的误差分解理论保证。
en_tdlr: FUTON models signals as generalized Fourier series whose coefficients are parameterized by low-rank tensor decomposition, combining Fourier and low-rank inductive biases with a provable exact error decomposition for implicit neural representations.
